cases.situation: I'm a web developer. Client Karen wants the new booking feature live by Monday for a promo. It's a 7-day job and I have another launch due Thursday.
cases.reply: Hi Karen, I'd love to get this live for your promo. Done properly, the booking feature is about seven working days, and I have a launch due Thursday, so Monday isn't possible. What I can do: a simple booking request form live by Monday that emails you each request, and the full calendar booking by Wednesday the 21st. Would that work for the promo?
cases.note: The no comes with a version of yes that serves her actual goal, the promo.

cases.situation: 我做品牌logo设计，合同里两轮修改已经用完了，客户王总又要改颜色和字体。不想无限免费改下去。
cases.reply: 王总，收到您的修改意见。合同里包含两轮修改，目前两轮都已经用完。这次颜色和字体的调整，我作为一次性的额外修改帮您做，之后每轮修改按800元收费。您看这样可以吗？确认后我周四前把新版发给您。
cases.note: 免费的只做一次，并且明说是一次性的，否则会变成默认。

cases.situation: Client says adding a blog section is 'a tiny change, the last agency threw that stuff in.' I quoted $1,800 for it.
cases.reply: I get that it looks small from the outside. At our end it's a new template, the CMS setup and moving your 40 existing posts across, about five days of work, so $1,800 is the fair number. If the budget's fixed, we can swap it in for the careers page. Just tell me which way you'd like to go.
cases.note: Don't lower the quote and don't start the work until they choose.

cases.situation: I run social media for a restaurant group on a $1,500/month retainer that covers 12 posts a month. The owner, Luca, now wants me to also answer all their Instagram DMs and Google reviews every day.
cases.reply: Hi Luca, good call, the DMs are where a lot of your bookings start. Daily inbox and review replies aren't part of the current retainer, which covers the 12 posts a month. Two ways to do it: I add community management for $600 a month from November, or we drop to 8 posts and I cover the inbox within the $1,500. Which works better for you?
cases.note: On a retainer, offer a swap as well as a price so the client can say yes without a bigger budget.

cases.situation: I'm a freelance photographer. A friend of a friend, Priya, wants product photos for her candle shop and asked for 'mates rates', half my usual $900 day rate, since we know people in common.
cases.reply: Hi Priya, lovely to hear from you, and the candles look great. My rate is set for the work rather than who it's for, so a full day of product shots is $900. If that's more than you'd planned, I can do a half day for $500 covering your 10 bestsellers on a white background, which is usually what a shop needs first. Which would suit you better?
cases.note: Hold the price and scale the scope. A friend discount given once becomes the rate everyone in that circle expects.
